customers.evidence: We put our customers and people first

employees.evidence: We will elevate our people practices to ensure our people feel welcomed, valued, and part of the McDonald’s community

dei.evidence: Inclusion We open our doors to everyone

integrity.evidence: Integrity We do the right thing

safety.evidence: committed to fostering a safe, respectful and inclusive workplace

innovation.evidence: getting faster, more innovative and more efficient at solving problems for our customers and people

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, absolute phrasing ('We put', 'We do') in a short-value list format. Customers are foregrounded first, then people and inclusion. Mostly first-person plural voice. Financial and environmental content is largely absent; growth is mentioned only briefly. Values are framed as a filter for decisions.
